Why unstitched

A fit that nobody else has.

Ready-to-wear is a compromise with someone else's measurements. Unstitched cloth is the opposite: you choose the shade, the length, the collar, the fall. Four and a quarter metres, buttons and labels in the bag, and a tailor who knows your shoulder.
